SELECT distinct A.SEC_ID secId, A.SEC_ABBR secAbbr, A.TERM_YEARS termYears, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.SEC_GRADE_RESULT secGradeResult, A.ISSUER_GRADE_RESULT issuerGradeResult, A.BID_PRICE_MIN bidPriceMin, A.BID_PRICE_MAX bidPriceMax, A.ISSUE_RATE issueRate, A.ISSUER issuer, A.SPONSOR sponsor, A.OTH_CLAUSE othClause, A.BID_DATE bidDate, A.PAY_DATE payDate, A.ONMARKET_DATE onmarketDate, A.MAIN_SALER mainSaler, A.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, A.REGIST_ORG registOrg, B.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName, C.CUSTOMER_NAME sponsorName, D.CUSTOMER_NAME mainSalerName FROM MST_SECRELEASE_INFO A LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO B ON B.CUSTOMER_ID = A.ISSUER LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO C ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = A.SPONSOR LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO D ON D.CUSTOMER_ID = A.MAIN_SALER
BID_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{sbidDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND BID_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{ebidDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
